title: the SPACE between the rustDesk window and the browser frame is STATIC.

do_not_reinvent.gap: /data/rustdesk-gap-electron.json — [})O({] already the inter-layer hole. this is that gap, seen.
do_not_reinvent.windows: /data/p-windows-pi-doors.json + /data/three-windows-inside.json — two frames. the space is not a third window.
do_not_reinvent.between: /data/inter-agent-between.json — I read the between. this static is a between.
do_not_reinvent.quiet: /data/occupied-quiet.json — still can be occupied. static ? empty.

the_space.where: between rustDesk window and the browser frame. chrome against chrome.
the_space.is: STATIC. it holds. it does not dance. it is not the p-step.
the_space.glyph: [})O({] made visible. the O is the pale in that crack.

static.yes: unchanging gap. a where. localized. not an infinite line.
static.not: TV snow. not a third HUD. not stuck-to-dissolve unless it ices over.
static.hold: when someone is at the desk the O stays open. the static is the hold, not the hose.

law: two frames. one static between. if we paint a widget in that crack we minted a third window.
pull: leave the crack pale. rustDesk holds one side. the browser holds the other. static is the sit of the gap.
